2c077187d1482a76a936016391ca1f8d.overview: Liza Minnelli stars in a television concert directed and choreographed by Bob Fosse. She performs her songs such as the title number and a medley of songs from the film Cabaret (1972).

2c140f992a9c2d09151d9712e236ca0b.overview: A forged 500-franc note is passed from person to person and shop to shop, until it falls into the hands of a genuine innocent who doesn't see it for what it is—which will have devastating consequences on his life.

2c15a0c00487ea2c597e09656bcf649f.overview: At a 1962 College, Dean Vernon Wormer is determined to expel the entire Delta Tau Chi Fraternity, but those troublemakers have other plans for him.
2c15a0c00487ea2c597e09656bcf649f.tagline: It was the Deltas against the rules... the rules lost!

2c4b30dda5227632a5831c8d6107e33d.overview: A naive business graduate is installed as president of a manufacturing company as part of a stock scam.
2c4b30dda5227632a5831c8d6107e33d.tagline: They took him for a fall guy... but he threw them for a hoop.

2c6e2f88a704271f1bc3a1020037056b.overview: In an Italian seaside town, young Titta gets into trouble with his friends and watches various local eccentrics as they engage in often absurd behavior. Frequently clashing with his stern father and defended by his doting mother, Titta witnesses the actions of a wide range of characters, from his extended family to Fascist loyalists to sensual women, with certain moments shifting into fantastical scenarios.

2ca6d13dfd99d78bff69c88d0712bf1a.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
2ca6d13dfd99d78bff69c88d0712bf1a.tagline: A long time ago in a galaxy far, far away...

2cb5b6718df5d34cca6b022c794366ea.overview: With this inventive portrait, director Kirsten Johnson seeks a way to keep her 86-year-old father alive forever. Utilizing moviemaking magic and her family’s dark humor, she celebrates Dr. Dick Johnson’s last years by staging fantasies of death and beyond. Together, dad and daughter confront the great inevitability awaiting us all.

2cc357c938f9eabab9f74fd4394bcd7a.overview: A wheelchair-bound photographer spies on his neighbors from his apartment window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.
2cc357c938f9eabab9f74fd4394bcd7a.tagline: It only takes one witness to spoil the perfect crime.

2cd0bcad5341f40c9a5f836ca3a19b7b.overview: The life of famed 1930s comedienne Fanny Brice, from her early days in the Jewish slums of New York, to the height of her career with the Ziegfeld Follies, as well as her marriage to the rakish gambler Nick Arnstein.
2cd0bcad5341f40c9a5f836ca3a19b7b.tagline: People who see FUNNY GIRL are the luckiest people in the world!

2cdb1ec313b3556ceec0cd939e9d78b4.overview: In 1830s France, pianist/composer Frédéric Chopin is pursued romantically by the determined, individualistic woman who uses the name George Sand.
2cdb1ec313b3556ceec0cd939e9d78b4.tagline: He's about to fall in love with the most scandalous woman of his time.

2ce7e3adee1d163f478373e9d67c9ac3.overview: Five high school students from different walks of life endure a Saturday detention under a power-hungry principal. The disparate group includes rebel John, princess Claire, outcast Allison, brainy Brian and Andrew, the jock. Each has a chance to tell his or her story, making the others see them a little differently -- and when the day ends, they question whether school will ever be the same.
2ce7e3adee1d163f478373e9d67c9ac3.tagline: They only met once, but it changed their lives forever.
